text:
Maya L: Quick heads-up — I'm trying to lock the release brief for the SDK migration (Windows target). Need final snippets + one small known-issue blurb before I publish. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4783

Chris R: On it. Which snippets do you want? basic install + streaming example?

Maya L: Install, auth example, and a tiny streaming snippet showing fallback behavior on Win. Also a note about the MSVC redistributable requirement.

Li Wei: FYI the Windows CI caught a weird behavior: streaming + large context hits a tokenization fallback that slows it 3-4x. Filed an internal bug: https://internal.redwood/issue/7421 (will paste public issue once triaged).

Amanda P: Can we document a workaround? e.g., set `streaming_buffer_size: 256` or use the non-stream path?

Tom (QA): Confirmed the workaround helps. Also seeing an edge-case crash when using the old `redwood-sdk-win` wheel on Python 3.11 — upgrade to 2.0.0 wheel in PR fixes it.

Maya L: Ok add a "Known Windows caveats" callout in release notes: MSVC runtime, streaming perf regression (workaround), and wheel compatibility (force 2.0.0+). I'll paste the copy.

Chris R: Draft for callout: > Windows: If you use the SDK on Windows, install the Visual C++ Redistributable (2019+). Streaming on some older GPUs may be slower; set `streaming_buffer_size` or use non-stream mode as a fallback. For Python 3.11, use redwood-sdk>=2.0.0. Thoughts?

Li Wei: Fine. Add a tiny code example for the fallback pattern:
```python
# fallback to non-streaming if stream perf is bad
try:
    for chunk in client.chat.stream(...):
        process(chunk)
except StreamPerfError:
    resp = client.chat.create(..., stream=False)
    process(resp)
```

Amanda P: Looks good. Can you also add a small Windows-specific troubleshooting link to the migration guide? (docs/migration/windows.md)

Maya L: Will create that doc and link from both the SDK migration page and relnotes. Who can add the link fixes? PR 4783 currently modifies relnotes; need someone to sweep cross-links.

Chris R: I can do a quick link sweep after the docs-bot checks. I'll run the anchor linter.

docs-bot: Link check queued: docs/ -> anchor-lint run (job #12564).

Tom (QA): Also request: smoke test the snippet on a Windows VM with GPU runtime. I can run it tomorrow morning — will post results here.

Maya L: Perfect. Last ask: please keep the release note short — 3 bullets + callout. Avoid long migration steps in the relnotes; link to the full migration guide. I'll merge once CI + link sweep pass. :thumbsup:

Chris R: Merging checklist for me: 1) update snippets in PR 4783, 2) run anchor-lint, 3) add link to docs/migration/windows.md, 4) tag for docs review. ETA 2pm PT.

Li Wei: I'll follow up on the perf bug; if it becomes a blocker we may add a hotfix note.

Maya L: Thanks all — I'll queue the publish once Tom confirms smoke test.

Tom (QA): Smoke test done: install + basic auth snippet passes; streaming example exhibits slowdown but no crash on the test VM. Posting logs in #eng-qa shortly.
